head_commit.message:
fix(tui): improve diff view visibility on dark themes

Use LightGreen and LightRed colors instead of Green and Red for diff
highlighting. The "light" color variants are the bright ANSI colors
which have better visibility on dark terminal themes where standard
green/red can appear too dark.

Fixes #9694

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
